# Not found (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Owns the `NotFoundPage` content query (`notFoundText`) and its loader, used only by the catch-all route `app/[...unknownPath]/not-found.tsx` (a query in a `not-found.tsx` runs on every render under its segment, so only a segment that is all not-found renders may hold it; the root `app/not-found.tsx` loads no data and shows `LAST_RESORT_TEXT`). Both render `NotFoundMessage` ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md), PS-1, PS-2).

## Techniques

`NotFoundPage.graphql.ts` is client-safe; `NotFoundPage.server.ts` is `server-only`. `notFoundText` is a GraphQL alias of the cms-api root field `siteText`. `loadNotFoundText` is in React `cache` and returns `null` with one logged `NO_DATA` error when it failed; the page then shows `LAST_RESORT_TEXT`.

## Technologies

React (`cache`); `graphql` (dev, in specs).

## Entry points

`loadNotFoundText`, `NOT_FOUND_PAGE_QUERY` (server file), `NotFoundText`, `NotFoundMessage`.

## Where to change what

A new not-found text: add it to `NOT_FOUND_PAGE_ROOT_FIELDS`, the type and `NotFoundPage.mock.ts` together; the spec fails when they differ.
